name: Microchip Technology Incorporated
blurb: Microchip Technology is a leading supplier of 8/16/32-bit microcontrollers and analog semiconductors, with a deep power-management portfolio covering PMICs, LDO regulators, DC-DC controllers, gate drivers for MOSFETs and IGBTs, and SiC gate drivers under its mSiC brand. It is one of the largest suppliers of mixed-signal and connectivity ICs for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and data-centre applications. Its Digitally Enhanced Power Analog (DEPA) controllers and 600V gate driver families address the high-voltage side of AI server power delivery, while its broad PMIC lineup targets point-of-load regulation for FPGAs, MPUs, and ASICs in compute racks.
recent: Microchip reported Q3 FY2026 (quarter ending December 2025) net sales of $1.186 billion, up 15.6% year-over-year and beating guidance, with non-GAAP EPS of $0.44 against a $0.39 consensus. CEO Steve Sanghi cited broad-based recovery across end markets, non-GAAP gross margins expanding from 52% to 60.5%, and strong bookings building into the March 2026 quarter. Q4 FY2026 guidance was set at $1.26 billion (midpoint), representing roughly 30% year-over-year growth, with EPS of $0.48–$0.52. The company also introduced a new 600V gate driver family and the MCP16701 PMIC targeting AI, high-performance computing, and data-centre applications in early 2026.
